info.title: LayMatched Customer Activation API
info.description: Authoritative activation integration contract for authenticated installation recognition and activation state. Installer credentials remain at the Auth API and are never forwarded to the central application.

servers.description: Production authority; implementation is outside Slice 0

post.summary: Create or resume an activation from an Auth API assertion
post.description: The Auth API validates the installer credential and resolves customer identity before issuing this short-lived assertion. The installer credential is never forwarded to the central application or exposed to browser JavaScript.
Only installation ID, application version and explicit service status are recorded; the server supplies received_at. Missing or overdue contact is unknown or stale, never healthy.

post.summary: Issue a new short-lived activation session to a registered installation
post.description: Used after browser reload, interruption, JWT expiry, or VPS reboot. The installation identifier selects the registered public key but does not authenticate the caller. The request must be signed by that installation key. A fresh signature nonce is required for every transport retry; an identical Idempotency-Key and body return the original response.

200.description: Short-lived session issued or original idempotent response replayed

get.summary: Get activation, entitlement, and provisioning status

post.summary: Perform an advisory nickname availability check
post.description: Availability is advisory. Only a successful transactional reservation grants ownership.

201.description: Nickname reserved and DNS reconciliation queued immediately; network ownership proof remains a separate required activation gate

post.summary: Renew the authenticated activation's existing nickname reservation
post.description: Extends the same reservation while activation is legitimately pending or retrying. It never changes nickname ownership and cannot revive an expired, released, quarantined, terminal, or differently owned reservation. Once committed, reservation_expires_at is null and renewal is an idempotent no-op.

200.description: Reservation renewed, already renewed idempotently, or already committed

patch.summary: Enrich the authenticated customer's central profile
patch.description: Profile fields enrich the customer already resolved from installation identity; they never select or replace that identity.

post.summary: Issue a fresh network ownership challenge for the same reservation
post.description: Requires the same authenticated activation session and installation signature as other activation mutations. The reservation and installation identity are fixed; refresh does not prove network ownership or permit activation by itself.

200.description: Fresh short-lived challenge bound to the existing activation reservation

put.summary: Submit signed network state and reachability proof
put.description: Submits mandatory network ownership proof using the current short-lived activation-bound challenge. DNS reconciliation is already queued at reservation and is requeued if the proven address changes.

202.description: Network proof or DNS reconciliation pending

post.summary: Report local certificate metadata for independent verification
post.description: Only public certificate metadata is accepted. No ACME account key, certificate private key, or DNS credential may be submitted.

post.summary: Deactivate an authenticated installation and withdraw its hostname
post.description: Deactivation is terminal for the activation. DNS withdrawal is queued and ownership-checked; the nickname remains quarantined before later reuse.

202.description: Deactivation accepted; DNS withdrawal is pending or not required

put.summary: Report locally verified MFA status only
put.description: The TOTP secret, OTP values, provisioning URI, QR payload, recovery codes, and recovery-code hashes are forbidden. The local service verifies MFA and reports only status metadata.

post.summary: Complete activation after all central and local gates pass
post.description: The local application establishes its own authenticated session after completion. The central service does not issue a private application session.

InstallerCredential.description: Bootstrap credential used only by the installer or local backend; never exposed to browser JavaScript.

ActivationAssertion.description: Short-lived Auth API assertion containing the already-resolved customer/licence identity. It is accepted only by the central activation service and never contains the installer credential.

InstallationIdentity.name: X-Installation-Id
InstallationIdentity.description: Public immutable installation identifier used to locate the registered Ed25519 public key. It is not a credential and is accepted only with InstallationSignature.

InstallationSignature.name: X-Installation-Signature
InstallationSignature.description: Base64url Ed25519 signature over the canonical method, path, body hash, X-Signature-Timestamp, and X-Signature-Nonce.

InstallationId.name: X-Installation-Id
InstallationId.description: Immutable installation UUID. Authentication is provided by the accompanying Ed25519 signature.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: UUID scoped to installation and operation. Reuse with an identical request replays the original response; reuse with a different request returns conflict.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: ETag returned by the latest activation status response.

ErrorDetails.description: Provider-neutral, customer-safe recovery context. Provider names, identifiers, credentials, request payloads, and raw errors are forbidden.

installation_public_key.description: Base64url-encoded Ed25519 public key. The private key remains on the VPS.

ActivationSessionRequest.description: Contains no installer credential. The registered installation key authenticates session resumption.

Membership.description: Safe entitlement metadata only. Stripe customer/subscription identifiers and Stripe credentials are never returned.

ProfileUpdateRequest.description: Enrichment only. Email and customer identifiers are deliberately absent.

Nickname.description: Normalized lowercase LDH nickname. Reserved-name policy is additionally enforced centrally.

reservation_expires_at.description: Null after hostname ownership is committed.

retry_after.description: Null after hostname ownership is committed.

network_challenge.description: Short-lived public reachability challenge; never a credential.

NicknameReservationRenewalRequest.description: The server applies its bounded lease policy; this value cannot create or transfer ownership.

challenge_response.description: Signed response to a server-issued reachability challenge.

challenge_nonce.description: Short-lived HTTPS reachability challenge; never a credential.

MfaStatusUpdateRequest.description: Status metadata only. Secrets, OTPs, provisioning payloads, and recovery-code material are prohibited by additionalProperties=false.

network_verified.description: Whether independent public-IP ownership proof has succeeded.

InvalidCredential.description: Credential invalid, expired, signature invalid, or replay detected

LicenceInactive.description: The authenticated customer's licence is not active

NotFound.description: Activation not found for the authenticated installation

Conflict.description: State, version, nickname, or idempotency conflict
